svg.text: From a BBR unit to a point on the map
Example building Eksempelgade 12–14 (made up). One BBR building, two entrances (two DAR house numbers), 16 flats. Selected: Eksempelgade 12, 2. tv.

g.text: The same building seen from above
BBR gives one point per building (byg404Koordinat). DAR gives one point per entrance (DAR_Adressepunkt),
so flats on different staircases get different address points; flats on the same staircase share one.

svg.text: The joins: each arrow matches an id field to id_lokalId in the next table
Ids are shortened and made up; real ids are full UUIDs such as
Highlighted fields: blue/brown = the id fields that join;
outlined = what the join is for (address text or coordinates).
